references.title: DWDS: Bauer
references.supports: No Wortzerlegung for das Bauer, the birdcage; Herkunft ahd. būr 'Wohnung, Vorratshaus' (8th c.), not from bauen

notes.rationale: The birdcage, das Bauer. DWDS gives this homograph no Wortzerlegung, so it is a bottom word with no Constituents: the Root bauer and the zero ending (ADR 0051). der Bauer, the farmer, splits bauen + -er (ADR 0050: the Reading owns the split).
